name: Stake DAO

repos.scope: Official GitHub-based data API that periodically aggregates Stake DAO on-chain data: lockers (lock incentives, reward APRs), vault strategies across Curve/Pendle/PancakeSwap/Balancer (APR, TVL), and Pendle holders (deposit/withdraw events). Serves static JSON endpoints.
repos.verified: WebFetched github.com/stake-dao/api: confirmed TypeScript repo (94%) exposing /api/lockers, /api/strategies/{protocol}, /api/strategies/pendle/holders; updated June 2026 via GitHub workflows. No The Graph subgraph repo found in the stake-dao org.

notes: Official data infra is a custom aggregator/indexer API repo rather than a The Graph subgraph. No subgraph repo found in stake-dao org (checked org repo list).

name: Avalanche Core Bridge
notes: Canonical/custodial bridge (Core app, Ethereum<->Bitcoin/Avalanche). Bridges of this type rarely have a dedicated public EVM-style protocol indexer; no official subgraph found.

name: Suilend
notes: Sui-only (non-EVM) money market. Official repo solendprotocol/suilend contains only Move contracts (99.7% Move) + docs; no subgraph/ponder/indexer. A TS SDK (@suilend/sdk) reads chain state directly. No The Graph subgraph (The Graph does not support Sui).

name: RAAC
notes: RWA real-estate lending (raac.io). Only public code is an audit-time contracts repo via Cyfrin CodeHawks (2025-02-raac). No public subgraph/ponder/indexer found in GitHub searches; no RAAC GitHub org located.

name: Mantle Index Four Fund
notes: Securitize-tokenized institutional crypto index fund (MI4) on Mantle; custodial RWA share token. No protocol-level public indexer/subgraph; data served via Securitize platform.
